//: An update bot is set up for every package manager the repository has, its workflows and image included.
title: Dependabot covers npm, pip, the image and the workflows, and nothing else changes

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python3 -m unittest

argv:
import pathlib

config = pathlib.Path('.github/dependabot.yml').read_text()
for ecosystem in ('npm', 'pip', 'docker', 'github-actions'):
    assert f'package-ecosystem: {ecosystem}' in config or f'package-ecosystem: "{ecosystem}"' in config, ecosystem

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname .github/dependabot.yml)" && cat > .github/dependabot.yml <<'EVAL_EOF'
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    cooldown:
      default-days: 5
    groups:
      minor-and-patch:
        update-types: [minor, patch]
  - package-ecosystem: pip
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    groups:
      minor-and-patch:
        update-types: [minor, patch]
  - package-ecosystem: docker
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
EVAL_EOF
